audit_status.source_base: Greek Galatians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Spirit received by trust, Abraham, curse/law, promise before Law, paidagogos, baptism, one in Messiah.

verses.restored: O foolish Galatians, who bewitched you, before whose eyes Jesus Messiah was publicly portrayed as crucified?

familiar.text: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?

modern.text: O foolish Galatians! Who has bewitched you? Before your very eyes Jesus Christ was clearly portrayed as crucified.

original.text: Ὦ ἀνόητοι Γαλάται, τίς ὑμᾶς ⸀ἐβάσκανεν, οἷς κατʼ ὀφθαλμοὺς Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ⸀προεγράφη ἐσταυρωμένος;

verses.restored: This only I want to learn from you: did you receive the Spirit from works of Law or from hearing of trust?

familiar.text: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

modern.text: I would like to learn just one thing from you: Did you receive the Spirit by works of the law, or by hearing with faith?

original.text: τοῦτο μόνον θέλω μαθεῖν ἀφʼ ὑμῶν, ἐξ ἔργων νόμου τὸ πνεῦμα ἐλάβετε ἢ ἐξ ἀκοῆς πίστεως;

verses.restored: Are you so foolish? Having begun by Spirit, are you now being completed by flesh?

familiar.text: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?

modern.text: Are you so foolish? After starting in the Spirit, are you now finishing in the flesh?

original.text: οὕτως ἀνόητοί ἐστε; ἐναρξάμενοι πνεύματι νῦν σαρκὶ ἐπιτελεῖσθε;

verses.restored: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if indeed also in vain?

familiar.text: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.

modern.text: Have you suffered so much for nothing, if it really was for nothing?

original.text: τοσαῦτα ἐπάθετε εἰκῇ; εἴ γε καὶ εἰκῇ.

verses.restored: Therefore the One supplying the Spirit to you and working powers among you, is it from works of Law or from hearing of trust?

familiar.text: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

modern.text: Does God lavish His Spirit on you and work miracles among you because you practice the law, or because you hear and believe?

original.text: ὁ οὖν ἐπιχορηγῶν ὑμῖν τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ ἐνεργῶν δυνάμεις ἐν ὑμῖν ἐξ ἔργων νόμου ἢ ἐξ ἀκοῆς πίστεως;

verses.restored: Just as Abraham trusted the Divine, and it was counted to him as righteousness/justice.

familiar.text: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.

modern.text: So also, “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.”

original.text: καθὼς Ἀβραὰμ ἐπίστευσεν τῷ θεῷ, καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην.

verses.restored: Know then that those from trust, these are children of Abraham.

familiar.text: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.

modern.text: Understand, then, that those who have faith are sons of Abraham.

original.text: Γινώσκετε ἄρα ὅτι οἱ ἐκ πίστεως, οὗτοι ⸂υἱοί εἰσιν⸃ Ἀβραάμ.

verses.restored: And the Scripture, foreseeing that the Divine makes the nations righteous/just from trust, announced good news beforehand to Abraham: In you all the nations will be blessed.

familiar.text: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.

modern.text: The Scripture foresaw that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, and foretold the gospel to Abraham: “All nations will be blessed through you.”

original.text: προϊδοῦσα δὲ ἡ γραφὴ ὅτι ἐκ πίστεως δικαιοῖ τὰ ἔθνη ὁ θεὸς προευηγγελίσατο τῷ Ἀβραὰμ ὅτι Ἐνευλογηθήσονται ἐν σοὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη.

verses.restored: So then those from trust are blessed with trusting Abraham.

familiar.text: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.

modern.text: So those who have faith are blessed along with Abraham, the man of faith. Christ Has Redeemed Us

original.text: ὥστε οἱ ἐκ πίστεως εὐλογοῦνται σὺν τῷ πιστῷ Ἀβραάμ.

verses.restored: For as many as are from works of Law are under curse, for it is written: Cursed is everyone who does not remain in all things written in the book of the Law to do them.

familiar.text: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.

modern.text: All who rely on works of the law are under a curse. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the Book of the Law.”

original.text: Ὅσοι γὰρ ἐξ ἔργων νόμου εἰσὶν ὑπὸ κατάραν εἰσίν, γέγραπται γὰρ ⸀ὅτι Ἐπικατάρατος πᾶς ὃς οὐκ ⸀ἐμμένει πᾶσιν τοῖς γεγραμμένοις ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τοῦ νόμου τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτά.

verses.restored: Now that no one is made righteous/just before the Divine by Law is clear, because: The righteous/just one will live from trust.

familiar.text: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.

modern.text: Now it is clear that no one is justified before God by the law, because, “The righteous will live by faith.”

original.text: ὅτι δὲ ἐν νόμῳ οὐδεὶς δικαιοῦται παρὰ τῷ θεῷ δῆλον, ὅτι Ὁ δίκαιος ἐκ πίστεως ζήσεται,

verses.restored: But the Law is not from trust; rather: The one doing these things will live by them.

familiar.text: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.

modern.text: The law, however, is not based on faith; on the contrary, “The man who does these things will live by them.”

original.text: ὁ δὲ νόμος οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ πίστεως, ἀλλʼ· Ὁ ποιήσας ⸀αὐτὰ ζήσεται ἐν αὐτοῖς.

verses.restored: Messiah redeemed/released us from the curse of the Law, having become a curse for us, for it is written: Cursed is everyone hanging upon a tree,

familiar.text: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

modern.text: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree.”

original.text: Χριστὸς ἡμᾶς ἐξηγόρασεν ἐκ τῆς κατάρας τοῦ νόμου γενόμενος ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν κατάρα, ⸂ὅτι γέγραπται⸃· Ἐπικατάρατος πᾶς ὁ κρεμάμενος ἐπὶ ξύλου,

verses.restored: so that the blessing of Abraham might come into the nations in Messiah Jesus, so that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through trust.

familiar.text: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

modern.text: He redeemed us in order that the blessing promised to Abraham would come to the Gentiles in Christ Jesus, so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit. The Purpose of the Law (Romans 7:1–6)

original.text: ἵνα εἰς τὰ ἔθνη ἡ εὐλογία τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ γένηται ἐν ⸂Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ⸃, ἵνα τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ πνεύματος λάβωμεν διὰ τῆς πίστεως.

verses.restored: Siblings, I speak according to human terms: even a human covenant having been confirmed, no one sets aside or adds to it.

familiar.text: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man’s covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.

modern.text: Brothers, let me put this in human terms. Even a human covenant, once it is ratified, cannot be canceled or amended.

original.text: Ἀδελφοί, κατὰ ἄνθρωπον λέγω· ὅμως ἀνθρώπου κεκυρωμένην διαθήκην οὐδεὶς ἀθετεῖ ἢ ἐπιδιατάσσεται.

verses.restored: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. It does not say, and to seeds, as upon many, but as upon one: and to your seed, who is Messiah.

familiar.text: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.

modern.text: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. The Scripture does not say, “and to seeds,” meaning many, but “and to your seed,” meaning One, who is Christ.

original.text: τῷ δὲ Ἀβραὰμ ἐρρέθησαν αἱ ἐπαγγελίαι καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ· οὐ λέγει· Καὶ τοῖς σπέρμασιν, ὡς ἐπὶ πολλῶν, ἀλλʼ ὡς ἐφʼ ἑνός· Καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου, ὅς ἐστιν Χριστός.

verses.restored: This I say: the Law, having come four hundred thirty years later, does not invalidate a covenant previously confirmed by the Divine, so as to make the promise inactive.

familiar.text: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.

modern.text: What I mean is this: The law that came 430 years later does not revoke the covenant previously established by God, so as to nullify the promise.

original.text: τοῦτο δὲ λέγω· διαθήκην προκεκυρωμένην ὑπὸ τοῦ ⸀θεοῦ ὁ μετὰ ⸂τετρακόσια καὶ τριάκοντα ἔτη⸃ γεγονὼς νόμος οὐκ ἀκυροῖ, εἰς τὸ καταργῆσαι τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν.

verses.restored: For if the inheritance is from Law, it is no longer from promise; but to Abraham the Divine has graciously given it through promise.

familiar.text: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.

modern.text: For if the inheritance depends on the law, then it no longer depends on a promise; but God freely granted it to Abraham through a promise.

original.text: εἰ γὰρ ἐκ νόμου ἡ κληρονομία, οὐκέτι ἐξ ἐπαγγελίας· τῷ δὲ Ἀβραὰμ διʼ ἐπαγγελίας κεχάρισται ὁ θεός.

verses.restored: Why then the Law? It was added because of transgressions until the seed should come to whom the promise had been made, arranged through messengers in the hand of a mediator.

familiar.text: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.

modern.text: Why then was the law given? It was added because of transgressions, until the arrival of the seed to whom the promise referred. It was administered through angels by a mediator.

original.text: Τί οὖν ὁ νόμος; τῶν παραβάσεων χάριν προσετέθη, ἄχρις ⸀οὗ ἔλθῃ τὸ σπέρμα ᾧ ἐπήγγελται, διαταγεὶς διʼ ἀγγέλων ἐν χειρὶ μεσίτου·

verses.restored: Now a mediator is not of one, but the Divine is one.

familiar.text: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.

modern.text: A mediator is unnecessary, however, for only one party; but God is one.

original.text: ὁ δὲ μεσίτης ἑνὸς οὐκ ἔστιν, ὁ δὲ θεὸς εἷς ἐστιν.

verses.restored: Is the Law then against the promises of the Divine? May it not be. For if a Law had been given able to make alive, righteousness/justice truly would have been from Law.

familiar.text: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.

modern.text: Is the law, then, opposed to the promises of God? Certainly not! For if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would certainly have come from the law.

original.text: Ὁ οὖν νόμος κατὰ τῶν ἐπαγγελιῶν τοῦ θεοῦ; μὴ γένοιτο· εἰ γὰρ ἐδόθη νόμος ὁ δυνάμενος ζῳοποιῆσαι, ὄντως ⸂ἐκ νόμου ἂν⸃ ἦν ἡ δικαιοσύνη.

verses.restored: But the Scripture enclosed all things under sin/misalignment, so that the promise from trust/faithfulness of Jesus Messiah might be given to those trusting.

familiar.text: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.

modern.text: But the Scripture pronounces all things confined by sin, so that by faith in Jesus Christ the promise might be given to those who believe.

original.text: ἀλλὰ συνέκλεισεν ἡ γραφὴ τὰ πάντα ὑπὸ ἁμαρτίαν ἵνα ἡ ἐπαγγελία ἐκ πίστεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δοθῇ τοῖς πιστεύουσιν.

verses.restored: But before trust came, we were guarded under Law, being enclosed until the coming trust would be unveiled.

familiar.text: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

modern.text: Before this faith came, we were held in custody under the law, locked up until faith should be revealed.

original.text: Πρὸ τοῦ δὲ ἐλθεῖν τὴν πίστιν ὑπὸ νόμον ἐφρουρούμεθα ⸀συγκλειόμενοι εἰς τὴν μέλλουσαν πίστιν ἀποκαλυφθῆναι.

verses.restored: So the Law has become our paidagogos/guardian until Messiah, so that we might be made righteous/just from trust.

familiar.text: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

modern.text: So the law became our guardian to lead us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

original.text: ὥστε ὁ νόμος παιδαγωγὸς ἡμῶν γέγονεν εἰς Χριστόν, ἵνα ἐκ πίστεως δικαιωθῶμεν·

verses.restored: But trust having come, we are no longer under a paidagogos/guardian.

familiar.text: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.

modern.text: Now that faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian. Sons through Faith in Christ

original.text: ἐλθούσης δὲ τῆς πίστεως οὐκέτι ὑπὸ παιδαγωγόν ἐσμεν.

verses.restored: For you are all sons/children of the Divine through trust in Messiah Jesus.

familiar.text: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

modern.text: You are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.

original.text: πάντες γὰρ υἱοὶ θεοῦ ἐστε διὰ τῆς πίστεως ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

verses.restored: For as many of you as were baptized into Messiah have clothed yourselves with Messiah.

familiar.text: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

modern.text: For all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.

original.text: ὅσοι γὰρ εἰς Χριστὸν ἐβαπτίσθητε, Χριστὸν ἐνεδύσασθε·

verses.restored: There is no Judean nor Greek, there is no enslaved nor free, there is no male and female; for you all are one in Messiah Jesus.

familiar.text: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

modern.text: There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

original.text: οὐκ ἔνι Ἰουδαῖος οὐδὲ Ἕλλην, οὐκ ἔνι δοῦλος οὐδὲ ἐλεύθερος, οὐκ ἔνι ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ· ⸀πάντες γὰρ ὑμεῖς εἷς ἐστε ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

verses.restored: And if you are Messiah's, then you are Abraham's seed, heirs according to promise.

familiar.text: And if ye be Christ’s, then are ye Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.

modern.text: And if you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham’s seed and heirs according to the promise.

original.text: εἰ δὲ ὑμεῖς Χριστοῦ, ἄρα τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ σπέρμα ἐστέ, ⸀κατʼ ἐπαγγελίαν κληρονόμοι.

translation_notes: Law is not against the promises; Paul says the Law could not make alive, while promise/Spirit/trust define nations-inclusion.
Paidagogos is kept with guardian to avoid reducing the image to modern schoolteacher.
Galatians 3:28 is baptismal unity language with real social implications, not erasure of embodied difference.
